Title: Azure Site Recovery available in Azure Government Cloud

Body.Content:
U.S. public sector customers can use Azure Site Recovery (ASR) to protect their critical applications running on physical and virtual infrastructures, including Hyper-V and VMware. Some of the capabilities that come with ASR in Azure Government Cloud are:
  • Data security and secure transmission Data is encrypted during transit and at rest in Azure.
  • Screened personnel Azure Site Recovery operations and support in Azure Government cloud are performed by background-screened, U.S. citizen personnel.
  • Business continuity Azure Site Recovery is a highly reliable service, and it guarantees 99.9% availability as set forth in the ASR SLA.
  • Attractive pricing Customers can use Azure Site Recovery to protect their workloads at no charge for 31 days. For more information, see Azure Site Recovery Pricing
    • .
To get started, request an Azure Government trial subscription. If you already have an Azure Government subscription, simply try out Azure Site Recovery.
